title: Great Circle Distance
description: Computes the haversine great-circle distance between two WGS84 points using equatorial radius 6378137 m. Takes from and to as {latitude, longitude}, {lat, lon|lng}, or GeoJSON [longitude, latitude], plus optional unit m, km, mi, nmi, or ft (default m). Returns valid, meters, roundedMeters, distance in the requested unit, and unit. Invalid coordinates return valid:false with error and message.

from.description: Start point: {latitude, longitude}, {lat, lon|lng}, or [longitude, latitude].

to.description: End point, same forms as from.

unit.description: m (default), km, mi, nmi, or ft. Case-insensitive.
